messages:
Ari (AE): Quick pre-sales sync for Acme POC — they want a 2-week pilot. Need to lock success criteria, latency/cost targets, KMS/VPC requirements, and who runs the evals. Can we confirm?
Devon (SE): Proposed plan: 2-week POC = 1 week ramp + 1 week acceptance. Targets: p50 < 200ms for 256 tokens, p95 < 400ms, error_rate < 0.5%. Quality = 90% pass on their 150-prompt suite. Cost target: ~ $0.02 per 1k tokens avg (estimate).
Sam (Customer): That aligns. We'll do human review on 150 prompts and mark pass/fail. p95 can be up to 500ms for our UI. Budget for pilot is ~$8k (confirming).
Devon (SE): Eval modes: 1) Live-sampled traffic (approx 10k tokens/day) 2) Synthetic 150-prompt suite. Metrics: accuracy_pct, hallucination_rate, avg_tokens, p50/p95 latency, error_rate. We'll run quantized vs full model A/B.
Priya (Security): Security asks: customer-managed KMS, VPC peering (or egress controls), audit logs per request, SOC2 evidence, and data retention policy. Also they want logs kept in eu-west-1.
Nikhil (Infra): For 2-week POC we can do hosted with envelope encryption using their KMS plus regional logging pinned to eu-west-1. Full Private with VPC is possible but longer lead time. KMS binding ~72 hours after key ARN.
Ari (AE): Action items: Devon = eval plan + scripts. Nikhil = KMS setup steps and ETA. Priya = docs to send. I'll confirm pilot budget with Sam.
Devon (SE): Eval plan summary:
- 150 prompt suite, human labels
- A/B: quantized (4-bit) vs standard (16-bit)
- Metrics: accuracy_pct >= 90, hallucination_rate <= 3%, error_rate <= 0.5%
Devon (SE): Perf curl example (hosted API):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-1","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Sam (Customer): For A/B: if quantized drops quality >5% we won't accept it. We're specifically comparing 4-bit quantized vs baseline.
Priya (Security): Also need confirmation of audit log residency and retention. Please send the security questionnaire and I'll complete.
Nikhil (Infra): We can pin logs to eu-west-1 for their tenant on hosted and set retention after legal OK. VPC peering will need their infra contact; can do in parallel.
Devon (SE): Blockers to flag: sustained 200 qps peak requires Dedicated sizing. Hosted trial can simulate bursts but won't sustain 200 qps long-term without committed capacity. Also quantization fallout might require fallback to larger model.
Ari (AE): Sam, can you confirm expected peak QPS during pilot?
Sam (Customer): Normal ~50 qps, brief spikes up to 200 qps for a few minutes. Pilot traffic will be representative but not full production.
Devon (SE): Acceptance checklist for SRE/ops handoff:
- Eval CSV with per-prompt labels and aggregated metrics
- Perf dashboard (p50/p95, token cost, error rate)
- Security artifacts: KMS key ARN, VPC peering ticket, SOC2 excerpt
- Fallback policy: auto-route to larger model if p95 breach
Priya (Security): I'll provide SOC2 excerpt, KMS procedure doc, retention policy, and privacy addendum. Send questionnaire and we'll return it.
Ari (AE): Timeline proposed: Day 0-2 onboarding + KMS binding, Day 3-7 ramp + baseline, Day 8-12 A/B and stress tests, Day 13-14 acceptance. Anyone object?
Nikhil (Infra): KMS ETA = 72 hours after key ARN. VPC peering needs customer infra contact; can run in parallel.
Devon (SE): I'll create a small repo with runners, README, and a notebook to compute metrics (example):
```
def compute_metrics(results):
  total = len(results)
  acc = sum(1 for r in results if r['label']=='pass')/total*100
  hall = sum(1 for r in results if r['hallucinated'])/total*100
  return {'accuracy_pct': f"{acc:.2f}", 'hallucination_rate': f"{hall:.2f}"}
```
Ari (AE): Good. Please post final artifacts here by EOD tomorrow. I'll coordinate procurement for the $8k pilot.
deploy-bot: KMS binding ticket #45679 created (ETA 72h) :white_check_mark:
Devon (SE): Will post repo link and initial eval CSV ASAP.
Sam (Customer): Thanks — we'll send infra contact and the completed security questionnaire by EOD.
Ari (AE): Thanks everyone. Follow-ups in thread. :rocket:
